bioconda.name: mic-50-90
bioconda.summary: A Python package for bounding MIC distributions from incomplete susceptibility reports
bioconda.description:
Published antimicrobial susceptibility results often give only MIC50, MIC90, a range and a
few percentages. From these, and from exact or rounded counts, MIC-50-90 computes the smallest
and largest count the report allows in every MIC category and range, names the count that
would narrow an open question most, selects counts a laboratory can publish so that readers
can check its conclusions, and gives optional population bounds under stated sampling
assumptions.

biotools.summary: MIC-50-90 bounds minimum inhibitory concentration (MIC) distributions from incomplete antimicrobial susceptibility reports. From MIC50, MIC90, the observed range and exact or rounded counts, it computes the smallest and largest count the report allows in every MIC category and range, names the count that would narrow an open question most, selects the counts a laboratory can publish so that readers can check its conclusions, and gives optional population bounds under stated sampling assumptions. It is available as a Python package, a command-line program, a container image and three Galaxy tools.

function.note: Bounds for MIC category counts and population shares from MIC50, MIC90, observed range and counts; counts to request and counts to publish; verification of a received report.
